intro_text: Chef Marco is catering Mr. Holloway's charity gala tonight, and someone wants it to fail - spectacularly. Guests are arriving, and there is a faint smell of gas in the air. Make the kitchen safe first, then find out who the saboteur is and confront them with proof. Point the finger at the wrong person and the saboteur will finish the job.

npc_spawns.inspect_text: A chef with green-dyed hair and a spotless white jacket. He is sweating.
The event planner, clutching a clipboard like a shield.
The electrician, rewiring the party lights. His sleeves are rolled up.
Owner of Ward Fine Catering - Marco's biggest rival. She is not on the staff list.
The host, in a dark suit and green tie, rehearsing his speech.

item_definitions.inspect_text: A heavy wrench from a plumber's toolbox.
A name badge: 'Ward Fine Catering - Staff'. The clip is bent, as if it was torn off in a hurry.
Priya's staff list. Only Marco's team, Dale, and Priya were allowed in the kitchen. No one from Ward Fine Catering.
A Ward Fine Catering badge found where no Ward staff were allowed. Someone from Ward was here.
A burned-out fuse. Dale must have swapped it. It has nothing to do with gas.

events.text: The smell of gas is strong here. The fitting behind the oven has been loosened on purpose - you can see fresh scratches on the nut.
Gas is still hissing from the loosened fitting. You need a wrench.
Marco: 'Gas? Impossible, I checked the oven this morning! The plumber left his tools in the bathroom when he fixed the tub. Hurry!'
Next to the tub is a plumber's toolbox. You take the pipe wrench.
You tighten the fitting until the hissing stops. The kitchen is safe - for now. Now find who did this.
You are not sure what to tighten. Take a closer look at the oven first.
Wedged between the couch cushions is a name badge with a bent clip: 'Ward Fine Catering - Staff'.
Priya: 'The kitchen was staff only all day. Here is my list - check it yourself, I have a hundred guests to seat.'
Priya: 'Did you see Simone Ward came? I certainly did not invite her.'
No one from Ward Fine Catering was allowed inside - yet a Ward badge was torn off in the living room, a few steps from the kitchen.
Dale: 'I have been on these lights all afternoon. Smelled gas around five, but I figured it was the stove. Here, I swapped this fuse out - keep it, if you're collecting things.'
Dale: 'Lights are almost done. Mind the cables.'
Simone: 'Lovely party. Such a shame about the food - I hear the kitchen is having trouble.'
Holloway: 'If this gala fails, the children's hospital loses its new wing. Please, whatever is wrong, fix it.'
Simone looks at the badge, then at the closed gas line behind you. Her smile collapses.
Simone Ward is escorted out by security. The gala goes on, Marco's dinner is a triumph, and the hospital gets its new wing.
Simone smirks. 'Shouldn't you be worried about that smell?'
While you argue, a spark from the oven finds the leaking gas. Nobody is hurt, but the kitchen - and the gala - go up in smoke.
You accuse Dale. He storms off, the lights go dark mid-speech, and in the chaos the real saboteur strikes again.
Dale: 'Yep, that's the one I pulled. Blown fuses don't loosen gas pipes, friend.'
